name: Naga Sadow's Mothership
description: Naga Sadow's Mothership was a Sith Meditation Sphere that the Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow used as a flagship during the Great Hyperspace War. In 5000 BBY, the sphere was destroyed when Sadow made Primus Goluud go supernova during the Battle at Primus Goluud.
